review_notes: I read the whole file (lines 1–76) and Mathlib's Mathlib/Combinatorics/Quiver/Symmetric.lean. I also grepped all of Mathlib for instances or lemmas about `Symmetrify`. Mathlib has only `symmetrifyQuiver`, `HasReverse (Symmetrify V)`, `Symmetrify.of`, `lift` and `Prefunctor.symmetrify`. It has no Finite, Fintype or DecidableEq instances for `Symmetrify`, and no cardinality lemma for its arrows. The file's instances, `card_symmetrify_hom` and the `of.obj` lemmas therefore add facts Mathlib lacks. They do not introduce a competing definition of an existing concept. `symmetrify_of_obj_bijective` is a named wrapper around `Function.bijective_id`, which this rubric does not count as a defect. I did not search other Lean libraries or Batteries/core beyond the supplied roots. I found no justified finding.
